# UAT Plan

Plan user acceptance testing and write business-facing UAT scripts from requirements or acceptance criteria: from the release scope, produce the plan (in/out scope by business process, roles and sign-off owner, environments and test data, entry and exit criteria, defect triage rules, schedule) plus one step-by-step script per business scenario that business testers can run without the delivery team — each with requirement IDs, preconditions, tester role, priority, expected results, and empty result columns — then a coverage check listing any requirement no script covers. Nothing is marked passed, no dates, names or data values are invented, and no real personal or financial data ever goes into a script.
